Question: Assalam alaikum, I saw a dream last night wherin I was standing on the roof of a house along with my wife. I can see ocean and stones and many other buildings. Suddenly I observed kaba shareef and showed the same to my wife. We regretted not bringing the camera, so that we could heve captured a photograph. I was trying to get a more closer view of kaba suddenly my leg slipped and i was about to fall. My wife held my hand but we both fell to some other roof top and we were safe. We were not hurt out or could not feel the pain as we were very excited watching Kaba. Allah Hafiz. Answer ID: 15346 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1518/1240=D/1430) The sins and evils have encompassed the society, the evils are prevailing everywhere even the ibadat is also not free from it. The dream indicates the religious matters and good deeds should be kept free from the thoughts of sins, otherwise because of this fault the religious matters and prayers may go in vain. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
